meta.name: learn-codebase
meta.description: Prime a codebase by reading every source file in full. Use when starting work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user asks to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速熟悉陌生代码库的完整结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接手一个不熟悉的项目，需要快速理解代码全貌。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly understand the full structure of an unfamiliar codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just took over an unfamiliar project and need to grasp the codebase quickly.

howto.what: Claude 会逐个完整读取项目里的每一个源文件,一个都不跳过;遇到大文件就用 Read 工具的分页参数分块读到底。这会消耗较多 token,用来提前建立对代码库的理解。
howto.when: 当你开始接手一个新项目或不熟悉的项目时,或说出 “learn the codebase”、“read the codebase”、“prime” 等说法时触发。

say.text: 读一遍这个代码库,每个源文件都要完整看完
say.note: Claude 会逐个文件通读,大文件分块读取

say.text: 帮我 prime 一下这个项目,我要上手开发了
say.note: 它会先通读全部源文件再开始工作

say.text: 先熟悉这个仓库,再帮我改东西
say.note: 读取完成后它才基于完整上下文动手

howto.what_en: Claude reads every source file in the project in full, nothing skipped, paging through large files with the Read tool's offset and limit. It uses extra tokens up front to build understanding of the codebase.
howto.when_en: Use when starting work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user asks to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".

say_en.text: Read the whole codebase, every source file in full
say_en.note: It reads file by file, paging large files

say_en.text: Prime this project for me, I'm about to start working
say_en.note: It reads all source files before starting

say_en.text: Get familiar with this repo before changing anything
say_en.note: It works from the full context afterwards
